odin_ranges.metric: Gross decline in Orvan to Midgard wheat import value versus the same months a year earlier
odin_ranges.metric_definition: Absolute year-on-year fall in the value of wheat imports on the Orvan to Midgard route. Low bound is Nov-Dec 2026 vs Nov-Dec 2025; high bound is Sep-Dec 2026 vs Sep-Dec 2025. This is trade value that moved off the Orvan route, not economic loss or unmet import need. Vanir and Ravik substitute flows are not netted.
assumptions: Same-month prior-year value is the baseline for exposed trade.
The decline is gross on one route and combines the corridor expiry with the dock strike from 14 September 2026 (ORV-0032); the corridor-only share cannot be isolated.
Substitute flows (Vanir wheat, Ravik rail) are not netted, so this overstates net exposure by an unknown amount.

odin_ranges.uncertainty_note: Both bounds rest on verified calcs over tier-1 ministry rows (ORV-0009). Loki conceded the December-only low under A1-T1, so both advocates now agree on the Nov-Dec run-rate as the low and Sep-Dec as the high. Thor conceded under A1-L1 that this is a gross route decline. The tier-1 ministry note (ORV-0027/P14) documents a partial Vanir substitute flow from November, and ORV-0022/P5 says millers find it reliable enough for current demand. Confidence is medium, not high, because of the strike confound and the unnetted substitution.

sufficiency_reason: The evidence firmly establishes the event: the corridor expired on 10 September 2026 without renewal (tier-1 ORV-0016, corroborated by tier-2 sources, false renewal report corrected by ORV-0013). It also supports gross route-decline ranges for Midgard wheat and Midgard maize from tier-1 ministry rows. It is not enough for a reliable full briefing on net exposure. Tolan maize cannot be quantified at all. The Tolan wheat high bound rests on an unverified calc and tier-2 data. Substitute flows (Vanir, Ravik rail) are only partly measured and not verified by calc, so net exposure cannot be computed. The overlapping dock strike prevents attributing the declines to the corridor alone. Total imports by origin are missing, so import shares cannot be computed.
